q: How do you greet a group of people?

context.title: 你好
lines: A：你好！  (Hello!)
B：你好！  (Hello!)
A：您好！  (Hello! (polite))
B：你们好！  (Hello, everyone!)

why: 你们 is the plural of 你, so 你们好 greets several people. B says it to everyone.

not.您好！: 您 is polite for one person, not a group.
not.没关系。: That answers an apology, not a greeting.
not.对不起！: That is an apology, not a greeting.

q: Which greeting is the polite one?

not.你好！: It is the normal greeting, not the polite one.
not.你们好！: It greets several people; it is not about politeness.
not.没关系。: That means it is okay; it is not a greeting.

context.title: 没关系
lines: A：对不起！  (Sorry!)
B：没关系。  (That's okay.)
A：对不起，对不起！  (Sorry, so sorry!)
B：没关系，没关系。  (It's fine, it's fine.)

why: A says 对不起 and B replies 没关系, meaning it is okay.

not.你好！: That is a greeting; B answers the apology differently.
not.您好！: A polite greeting, not a reply to an apology.
not.你们好！: A greeting for a group, not a reply to sorry.
